title: Haldi relief read as a spearhead; sites called fortresses (kalesi)

tellings.quote: warlike they believe archaeologists believe firmly that what they're passing in their hand is a spearhead

plain: Near Lake Van in Turkey, a carving of a figure called Haldi holds something that archaeologists 'believe firmly' is a spearhead, and the ancient sites there are named kalesi, or fortresses, as if the people were warlike. Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient sites, tells Michels this without naming a source, and he questions that warlike reading.
